answer: Every action also carries a staked signal that decays unless peers attest it, and each attestation opens a thread linking attester to attestee. Sybil resistance can work through a slow-moving trust ledger: each identity must accumulate a glacier-paced history of verified contributions before it earns voting weight, so mass-registering fresh keys yields no advantage. Faking a thousand identities would require paying that stake across every thread, making the attack cost far exceed any reward. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
